problem_type: Blank-canvas connection creation allow-list omits video sources
symptom: Dragging from a video card to empty canvas silently cancels instead of opening the next-node menu; the same happens for ordinary and multi-result video cards.
direct_cause: useGenerationCanvasReactFlowMenus.handleConnectEnd only accepted text, image, or image-like source kinds before resolving the blank-canvas drop target, so video and video-like kinds called cancelConnection and never reached the creation menu.
class_root: Source capability and creation-menu targets were maintained as separate ad hoc lists, so a media source kind could be rendered with a connection handle yet be rejected by the blank-canvas connection boundary.
migration: No data migration. Existing edges and node records remain unchanged; video sources now follow the existing blank-canvas menu path.
affected_population: Users dragging any ordinary or multi-result video node to create the next connected media node
Future registry node kinds whose execution kind is video and that reach the React Flow source-handle path
entry_points: useGenerationCanvasReactFlowMenus.handleConnectEnd: blank-canvas drop eligibility and menu creation
invariants: Text, image-like, and video-like source nodes can create a connected media node on blank canvas.
Audio and model3d sources do not open a media creation menu when dropped on blank canvas.
The source capability predicate and the restricted creation menu target list are owned by one model module.
Existing-target and group connection paths remain unchanged.

door_reduction.why_not: The React Flow host wiring, menu hook, shared capability module, and overlay target list are distinct boundaries: each owns a different integration step, and collapsing them would reintroduce a second source or target policy. The shared module is the common decision point, while the two React Flow components remain explicit consumers.

residual_risks: The focused real Electron walkthrough now proves a normal video source can open the blank-canvas menu; multi-result video card coverage still relies on the shared registry-derived path and unit contract.
The restricted menu intentionally continues to offer image and video targets only; it does not add audio or model3d outputs.
internal_only_reason: The failure is caused by Nomi's own React Flow menu hook and generation-node registry; no external media protocol determines which source kinds may create a Nomi canvas node.

recurrence.reason: The same omission would affect every current or future video-like source, regardless of whether the card has variants, because the decision used kind eligibility rather than the card's result count.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs handleConnectEnd: checked both React Flow callback readers
rg sourceNode src/workbench/generationCanvas: checked source allow-lists and the restricted menu
src/workbench/generationCanvas/model/generationNodeKinds.ts: verified registry-derived image/video predicates cover ordinary and variant node kinds

generality_proof: The shared predicate derives capability from the generation registry's execution kind, so ordinary video and any video-like variant use the same branch. The restricted menu consumes the same module's target list, preventing source eligibility and menu targets from drifting independently.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own source eligibility for blank-canvas connected media creation and the target-kind list used by its menu.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: This branch previously cancelled video sources before drop-target resolution and now calls the shared registry-derived predicate.
The menu's restricted kinds previously duplicated image/video literals and now consumes CONNECTION_CREATE_NODE_KINDS from the shared boundary.
This callback handles already-valid node-to-node connections and does not decide blank-canvas source eligibility.

prevention.invariant: Every blank-canvas source decision uses the registry-derived image/video capability predicate, and the menu target list has one owner.
prevention.failure_mode: The policy test fails if video-like sources are removed or if the menu target list diverges from the shared contract.
prevention.strategy: Keep source eligibility and restricted target kinds in one model module and have both React Flow integration points consume it.

legacy_paths.rationale: No alternate connection implementation is deleted; the duplicated literal and narrow predicate are replaced at their existing integration sites.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency is changed; React Flow remains the existing connection kernel.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The model-layer policy is the single source eligibility and target-list owner, and the test covers text, image, video, image-like, and rejected media kinds.
